requirement_text: The founding or amending authority shall identify the exact coordinated governance editions, resolve conflicting provisions, and record the resulting allocation of authority before dependent decisions proceed. A later draft of a referenced document shall not replace the operative edition automatically.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Programme publications shall distinguish metamodel, record ontology, epistemic representation, normative assessment, jurisprudential status, institutional governance, political economy, and technical implementation wherever a requirement or claim depends on more than one of these layers.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall preserve the distinction between theoretical GR concepts and scoped operational requirements. Intentional narrowing, operationalization, or departure shall identify its foundation sources, alternatives, rationale, and recorded architectural decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Programme publications and public claims shall not present technical conformance, authentic provenance, a programme decision, or a recorded institutional finding as sufficient proof of factual truth, ethical legitimacy, legal validity, or international endorsement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall identify jurisdictional and institutional authority separately whenever a proposal concerns legal duties, rights, admissibility, liability, or public power. Unresolved applicability shall remain explicit.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each proposed programme work item shall identify the recognition or practical problem it addresses, its intended beneficiaries and affected interests, its anticipated contribution to the mission, and the evidence by which that contribution will be evaluated.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Programme evaluations shall distinguish demonstrated improvements in recording, interpretation, contestation, or practical response from broader claims about restored trust, justice, or future generative capacity. A broader claim shall identify its evidence and limitations.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall examine its own classification, recording, decision, and publication practices as potential sources of exclusion, dependency, and concentrated authority. Findings and corrective decisions shall enter the programme's maintained issue record.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme decision authority shall maintain a current statement of objectives that links active work to the mission, identifies the practical capacities being developed, and distinguishes intended benefits from effects supported by evaluation. Each annual review shall examine whether the active portfolio still addresses those objectives.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When prioritizing work, the programme decision authority shall record the relative need, affected interests, alternatives to new standardization, resource demands, dependencies, and consequences of delay. A priority based on available funding shall identify the resulting coverage gaps and influence conditions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where evidence shows that a programme activity materially undermines participation, inspectability, contestation, or future access, the responsible authority shall examine revision, narrowing, suspension, or closure and record the chosen response and follow-up evidence. Publication volume shall not alone justify continuation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each publication shall declare its class, maturity, version, responsible editor, and decision authority. Specifications, adopted Standards, policy proposals, governance documents, Technical Reports, and manuals shall retain their distinct authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall reserve the designation adopted Standard for an edition approved under its operative development procedure. A draft, schema, prototype, protocol, or technically normative Specification shall not acquire that designation through technical completion alone.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Standards-track work shall begin with a stated normative problem, scope, terminology, intended requirements, conformance subjects, and relevant constraints. A dependent Specification work item shall identify the reusable technical need that motivates it. Draft requirements and Specifications may co-evolve through pilots and review.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A policy proposal shall identify its intended institution or class of institutions, mandate assumptions, institutional alternatives, expected effects, safeguards, and evaluation approach. Its recommendations shall not amend technical conformance requirements outside the standards-development procedure.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Formal work-item approval shall depend on the governance launch conditions in this Charter and Directives Part 1. Preliminary source research, draft preparation, synthetic examples, and technical exploration shall retain their preliminary status while those conditions remain unmet.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme decision authority shall reserve approval of governance amendments, creation or material alteration of committee mandates, formal work-item initiation, Standard adoption, substantive publication maintenance, and agreements creating programme commitments. A delegation of an operational step shall not transfer a reserved decision unless the operative founding or governance instrument expressly permits it.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An editor or repository administrator shall exercise only recorded editorial or custodial powers. Technical ability to merge, publish, assign identifiers, change access, or remove material shall not substitute for authorization of a substantive decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before an authorized release, the release owner shall verify the applicable adoption or publication decision and the exact artifact set. If the intended public statement exceeds the recorded decision, the statement shall be corrected or referred for a new decision before release.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall provide a documented route for interested individuals to contribute proposals and comments and to receive reasoned dispositions. Employment, institutional sponsorship, a proprietary tool account, payment, or travel shall not be a prerequisite for submitting a relevant comment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The participant register shall distinguish participation in an individual capacity from authorized institutional representation. It shall record relevant affiliations, interests, assigned roles, and any limits on a representation mandate, subject to justified protection of sensitive information.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For each work item, the coordinator shall identify affected interests, reviewer competence needed, known participation gaps, outreach undertaken, and feasible measures for language, disability, time-zone, connectivity, and resource barriers. Unfilled gaps shall remain visible in progression decisions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall provide an asynchronous contribution route and a human-readable account of proposed substantive changes. A contribution requiring assistance with format shall be assessed for its substance after proportionate assistance or an accessible alternative has been offered.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The coordinator shall publish the purpose and actual availability of each contribution route, the information needed to handle a submission, access and attribution choices, and the process for obtaining assistance. Failed contact, inaccessible material, or unmet accommodation shall be recorded and referred to the responsible review chair.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Funding, institutional affiliation, authorship volume, technical access, or control of repository credentials shall not by itself confer decision rights or priority in comment disposition. The decision authority shall assess whether concentrated interests or unpaid-work burdens materially limit fair consideration.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Any restriction on participation shall state the conduct or process reason, its scope, duration or review trigger, responsible decision maker, and available challenge route. Restrictions shall not be imposed solely because a participant disputes a proposal or authoritative interpretation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before closing a review, the review chair shall examine recorded access failures and participation gaps, determine their materiality to the decision, and document extension, targeted outreach, alternative access, narrowed claims, or deferral as appropriate. The absence of a complaint shall not alone establish adequate access.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When an affected person cannot participate through the published format, the coordinator shall offer a feasible alternative or explain the resource limitation and a route to review it. An assisted submission shall preserve the contributor's intended meaning and identify substantive interpretation by the assisting person.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall distinguish endorsement, consultation, contribution, representation, and assent in public accounts. A participant's name, affiliation, or contribution shall not be used as evidence of support for a decision without an established basis for that attribution.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before constituting a decision roster, the programme decision authority shall publish the proposed decision scope, nominations route, closing date, competence or affected-perspective criteria, expected review commitment, and conflict rules. Eligible individuals shall have an accepted bounded role, disclosed relevant interests, agreed applicable conduct terms, and a recorded capacity for the particular decision. Institutional representation shall require an identified mandate.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Selection to or exclusion from a decision roster shall have recorded reasons against the announced criteria and an available procedural challenge. The authority shall assess concentrated interests and missing perspectives before fixing the roster. A roster shall not change during a ballot except through the correction and restart rules of Directives Part 1.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A change in an eligible person's affiliation, capacity, or material interest shall be assessed before their next affected decision. The coordinator shall record whether the accepted role remains valid, requires a new mandate, or requires recusal or replacement under the operative procedure.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An appointment shall identify the person, appointing authority, accepted mandate, decision limits, relevant interests, start date, term or review date, alternate or vacancy arrangement, and removal or replacement procedure. An office shall not be treated as staffed until acceptance is recorded.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme decision authority shall publish reasons for appointments, renewals, and removals at a level compatible with necessary protection. A challenged appointment or removal shall have access to neutral procedural review under Directives Part 1.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where one person holds multiple functions, each decision record shall identify the capacity exercised and any resulting conflict. A person shall not conduct the neutral review of their own challenged decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall not delegate a decision to an automated system. AI-assisted drafting, summarization, analysis, or validation shall retain an accountable human role responsible for checking the resulting material and recording consequential use.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall not exercise a delegated function while its required responsible role is vacant or recused without an authorized substitute. Unaffected preliminary work may continue with its status declared.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An appointment renewal or proposed removal shall receive a recorded grounds statement and an opportunity for the affected person and relevant participants to respond before a final decision. A non-conflicted authority shall decide the matter within its mandate and provide access to neutral procedural review. Urgent temporary protective measures shall follow the ethics policy and emergency procedure, with a stated review point.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before granting operational access for an appointed role, the appointing authority shall confirm the holder's accepted mandate, relevant competence or induction needs, conflict assessment, and knowledge of escalation and protection duties. Credentials shall be limited to the tasks actually assigned.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each role holder shall report inability to perform a material assigned duty, loss of required access, or a conflict preventing performance to the appointing authority. The authority shall assign an authorized substitute, narrow the activity, or defer dependent decisions and record the response.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A role handover shall identify pending decisions, deadlines, records and access responsibilities, conflicts, accepted commitments, and unresolved risks. The outgoing and incoming custodians shall verify transferred access and the disposition of credentials; absence of an outgoing holder shall be recorded with recovery actions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Role performance review shall consider completion and quality of assigned duties, handling of objections, protection of records, influence concerns, and resource limits. An adverse assessment shall identify evidence and permit a response before a final appointment action, subject to time-limited protective measures.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall identify this document as a Governance Working Draft until a founding adoption record identifies the adopting persons, their actual authority over programme resources and publications, the edition adopted, its effective date, and the scope of that authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An adoption record shall distinguish the programme's own publication authority from any claim to represent a profession, institution, community, jurisdiction, or international constituency. Each representation claim shall identify its actual mandate and limits.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before founding adoption, the prospective founding signatories shall identify their actual capacities and proposed commitments, publish the exact governance package within cleared rights, identify proposed appointments and decision-eligibility criteria, and announce a founding review that applies the public-review, comment-disposition, reply, and material-change periods in draft Directives Part 1 as explicit conditions of that founding process.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The founding signatories shall execute an adoption instrument only after review dispositions, a governance rehearsal, accepted minimum appointments, and independent assessment of the founding process are recorded. The instrument shall identify each signatory's express agreement, scope of commitment, dissent, outstanding limits, and the exact texts adopted. A person or institution shall not be bound or represented by a signature that lacks actual authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The founding instrument shall identify the first programme decision authority, its delegated limits, appointment and succession route, and review date. Founding adoption shall not itself approve GR/NWIP-001 or any technical Standard. Subsequent formal adoption and maintenance decisions shall use the applicable ballot and review rules of operative Directives Part 1, distinguishing substantive maintenance from editorial correction and confirmation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The founding review notice shall distinguish the proposed founding signatories from reviewers and commenters, identify the actual resources or functions they can commit, and explain how additional participation or an objection to authority will be considered. A claimed mandate disputed during review shall receive a reasoned disposition before reliance on that mandate.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Execution of the founding instrument shall identify the exact agreement accepted by each signatory, any reservation and its agreed effect, verification of assent, and satisfaction of effective conditions. An unsigned field, synthetic signature, or recorded invitation shall not be treated as assent.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each consequential progression, adoption, mandate, or appointment decision shall identify the operative procedure, authority, evidence considered, interests and recusals, alternatives, material objections, reasons, consequences, and review route.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A claim of consensus shall include evidence that relevant concerns were considered and that remaining substantial objections received reasoned treatment. Silence, elapsed time, a vote total, or lack of a funded alternative shall not alone establish consensus.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before formal work-item initiation, the governance launch record shall identify the adopted Charter and Directives, committee mandate, ethics and contribution arrangements, public-review route, maintenance and records arrangements, accepted appointments, and an available neutral procedural review route. It shall include the results and dispositions of a governance rehearsal.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: If neutral review is unavailable for a consequential contested decision, the programme shall defer that disputed progression or adoption decision and record the capacity gap. The programme shall continue research and drafting that do not depend on the contested authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The governance launch assessment shall classify each required capacity as available and evidenced, limited with a stated consequence, or unavailable. A rehearsal result shall be recorded separately from actual staffing, public review, permissions, and independent-review availability. Unmet mandatory launch conditions shall prevent formal work-item initiation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For a decision involving multiple functions, the decision record shall identify who prepared the evidence, who reviewed it, who decided, and who implements the result. Combined capacities shall be explicit, and the record shall identify which findings depend on independent consideration.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An amendment to governance shall follow the change and review procedure in Directives Part 1, state its effective date and transition arrangements, and preserve the prior edition. A procedure shall not be changed retrospectively solely to validate a disputed decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A request to interpret an operative governance provision shall identify the text, affected decision, competing readings, and practical consequences. The governance authority shall publish a reasoned interpretation within its mandate; an interpretation changing authority, eligibility, obligations, or minimum safeguards shall use the amendment procedure rather than operate as an editorial clarification.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A governance amendment shall assess pending proceedings and identify the edition governing each transition. A pending participant's opportunity for reply or procedural review shall not be removed by an undisclosed change of rule.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall maintain an inspectable record of material funding, in-kind support, decision-related conditions, and control of essential infrastructure. Restricted details shall have a stated reason for restriction and an accountable reviewer.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A funding or hosting arrangement shall not authorize a sponsor to suppress relevant criticism, require adoption of its preferred technical solution, or bypass review. Material changes in support shall trigger a capacity and continuity assessment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before accepting material support or expenditure commitments, the authorized holder shall record the purpose, amount or nature of support, actual committing authority, conditions, expected benefit, duration, and effect on independence and continuity. A contribution shall not create an undisclosed priority or publication veto.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme decision authority shall compare planned obligations with available financial, human, technical, and accessibility resources before authorizing an activity. An unfunded essential safeguard or maintenance duty shall be resolved by resourcing, scope reduction, or deferral rather than recorded as an assumed future capacity.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The coordinator shall maintain an inventory of essential repositories, identifiers, contact routes, publication locations, build resources, and protected record stores, with accountable custodians, actual access, recovery arrangements, and dependencies on external providers. Sensitive recovery information shall be protected.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The responsible custodian shall periodically exercise recovery of essential publication and decision records and record the recovered version, access limitations, failures, and corrective action. The review interval and extent shall reflect identified continuity risks and shall be included in the governance records schedule.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before a change of hosting or custody, the governance authority shall record preservation of identifiers, versions, access restrictions, permissions, and continuity of comment and review routes. Unrecoverable losses shall be disclosed with their effect on pending decisions and publication claims.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The records custodian shall maintain access to publication status, version history, work scopes, decision reasons, comment dispositions, and correction notices. Protection or deletion of underlying sensitive records shall retain a non-sensitive account of the action and its authority where permitted.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The records custodian shall distinguish operative decisions from proposals, superseded decisions, implementation reports, and unresolved questions. Corrections shall link the changed account to the reason and authority, preserving prior material subject to the applicable protection and retention decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where a public account omits protected material, the custodian shall record the basis and scope of restriction and the availability of authorized review. The public account shall disclose its limitation without revealing protected existence, identity, or content where that disclosure would defeat protection.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An external liaison, pilot, endorsement, submission, or agreement shall identify who is authorized to act, its purpose and limits, and any external institution's actual assent. Participation in the programme shall not be represented as institutional endorsement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An external agreement proposal shall identify the counterparty's actual mandate, authorized programme signatory, commitments and costs, control of resulting material, publication rights, protection duties, review and termination arrangements, and effects on programme independence. Unresolved authority or rights material to the agreement shall prevent execution of the affected commitment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An authorized spokesperson shall distinguish the programme's adopted position from personal analysis, a committee draft, or a policy option. An inaccurate public claim of adoption, affiliation, or representation shall receive a recorded correction through the same relevant communication route where feasible.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme decision authority shall review mission performance, participation gaps, concentrated influence, conflicts, unresolved appeals, review capacity, and maintenance resources at least annually with the programme account required by Directives Part 1 and after a material institutional change. The review shall record remedial actions, owners, and follow-up.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The annual governance review shall identify open corrective actions, repeated procedural failures, unresolved capacity gaps, resource concentration, overdue maintenance, and the practical effects of earlier remedies. The authority shall assign owners, review points, and escalation conditions for actions it retains.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A material governance failure shall receive an assessment of affected decisions and publications. The governance authority shall record whether renewed participation, independent review, correction, repetition of a stage, or suspension is required; correcting the administrative record shall not alone validate the original decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A transition to institutional or hybrid participation shall identify representation mandates, decision eligibility, related-entity influence, existing participant treatment, resource needs, and appeal independence, and shall undergo Charter amendment before the new model governs decisions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A proposal to suspend or close programme operations shall identify the reason, actual deciding authority, current commitments, pending reviews and complaints, custodial destination of publications and protected records, rights limits, and feasible maintenance or withdrawal arrangements. The transition shall be reviewed under Directives Part 1 before permanent disposition.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A closure or suspension notice shall state which activities stop, which publication statuses remain operative or change, the custodian and available contact route, and unresolved matters. It shall not represent loss of operational capacity as erasure of historical decisions or as retroactive cancellation of external uses.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A governance assessment shall identify the operative or experimentally assessed edition, review period, scope, assessor, interests, and evidence for each applicable Charter requirement. Results shall distinguish fulfilled, not fulfilled, not assessed, and not applicable, with reasons and corrective actions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An assessor shall examine actual records and demonstrated routes relevant to the claim, including appointments, decision authority, access, recusal, independent review, resources, and continuity. A blank template, announced intention, or unperformed rehearsal shall not be accepted as evidence of completed performance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme decision authority shall respond to material assessment findings with an action, owner, due or review date, and consequence for dependent decisions. A finding shall be closed only with recorded evidence of the action or a reasoned change of scope, while preserving any unresolved historical effect.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each governance evidence record shall include a stable identifier, record type, responsible actor, relevant date or interval, applicable governance edition, subject and version, evidence location or access limitation, status, related records, and correction history. Unknown information shall be explicitly identified rather than supplied by inference without attribution.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The appointing authority shall maintain the authority and appointment elements in this annex for each operative role and shall update the record when its holder, scope, interests, acceptance, or effective status changes.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The responsible decision maker shall ensure that a consequential decision has the decision and review elements in this annex before it is relied on for progression. Where evidence is restricted, authorized review access and a safe public account shall be identified.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The governance authority shall use the continuity and transition elements in this annex when authorizing a transfer, prolonged suspension, or closure and shall record material gaps and their disposition.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessor shall select evidence appropriate to the requirement using the minimum evidence families in Table~\ref{tab:charter-evidence}. An assessment based on sampling shall identify the population, selection rationale, excluded cases, and limits on conclusions. Documentary completeness shall not replace observation of a route whose actual availability is claimed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall apply the adopted Charter for decision authority and appointments, these Directives for development procedure, Directives Part 2 for drafting, and the adopted Ethics, Conflict-of-Interest, and Contribution Rights Policy for conduct, conflicts, and rights. A conflict between these instruments shall be referred to the governance authority and resolved before a dependent decision proceeds.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Every procedural decision shall identify its accountable decision maker, operative authority and procedure versions, input document versions, grounds, outcome, date, and review or appeal route. Drafting, a repository merge, an ADR, or successful compilation shall not constitute governance adoption or Standard approval.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An organizational function without an appointed holder and recorded mandate shall remain \texttt{UNASSIGNED}. Formal project initiation and adoption shall remain pending while required authority or an independent appeal route is unavailable. Preliminary research, drafting, and synthetic rehearsals may continue with explicit status labels.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before formal standards-project approval, the founding adoption record shall identify the founding basis, adopted governance texts and versions, participants and capacities, decision method, dissent, transitional limits, review date, and replacement route. Governance adoption shall follow the founding procedure recorded under the Charter, rather than assume that these draft Directives have already authorized themselves.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The governance authority shall assign oversight, project progression, public-review administration, release, maintenance, conflict handling, and independent appeal functions. The assignment register shall identify holders, terms, delegated limits, substitutes, and contact routes. Combined roles shall be disclosed; an interested decision maker shall not determine their own procedural appeal.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall maintain an accessible work programme and participation route. A project notice shall identify the problem, scope, current status, available documents, contribution terms, comment routes, decision roles, and intended review dates. Public comment shall not require voting membership or endorsement of the proposal.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The review chair shall document outreach to affected interests and relevant expertise, participation barriers, affiliations relevant to dominance, and remaining gaps. The chair shall provide an asynchronous contribution route and record requested accessibility or language accommodations and the response. Lack of response shall not be recorded as consent.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before a formal decision, the chair shall confirm current conflict declarations and apply the adopted recusal procedure. The record shall identify recusals and their effect on eligibility and quorum without disclosing protected details unnecessarily. If conflicts prevent a valid decision or impartial review, progression shall be deferred.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A New Work Item Proposal shall identify purpose, intended users and affected people, publication class, bounded deliverables, exclusions, proposed conformance subjects, alternatives to new standardization, source basis, dependencies, review expertise, pilot evidence, resource needs, and prospective maintenance responsibility.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The proposal shall explain how the work addresses warranted recognition or generative trajectory and identify epistemic assumptions, ethical impacts, legal and institutional boundaries, public-policy implications, accessibility, protection needs, and distribution of recording and implementation burdens. A claimed institutional mandate shall identify its source and limits.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The technical committee shall begin with the normative problem and assessment needs. A dependent Specification proposal shall identify the draft requirements requiring reusable technical infrastructure, the implementation alternatives, and intended tests. A protocol proposal shall additionally identify actors, interactions, states, transitions, outcomes, failure handling, and authority boundaries.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The authorized project decision maker shall record accept, revise, defer, or reject, with reasons, scope, assigned responsibilities, dependencies, and review milestones. A coordinated proposal shall retain a separate bounded scope and progression record for each deliverable. A technical dependency shall not acquire Standard status through inclusion in a proposal.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A proposed expansion beyond approved scope shall receive impact review and an explicit scope decision before dependent progression. A Specification intended for promotion to a Standard shall enter an explicit standards-track proposal and the applicable review stages; technical stability alone shall not authorize promotion.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall register a proposal with an identifier, receipt date, proposer, proposed class, scope version, and handling status. It shall acknowledge receipt within seven calendar days and identify the authority responsible for scheduling its consideration. An incomplete proposal shall receive a specific request for information or a reasoned deferral; registration shall not confer project approval.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before accepting a project, the decision authority shall verify that the editor and maintenance owner accept their responsibilities, required review competence can be obtained, the resource estimate includes participation and protection work, and the work plan states review dates and capacity limits. An unfilled essential role shall be resolved through assignment, a narrower scope, or deferral, rather than entered as an assumed resource.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The project register shall distinguish proposed, active, suspended, closed, and completed work and retain the reason for a change of status. A proposer may withdraw a proposal before authorization; withdrawal shall preserve its record and relevant unresolved issues. Suspension or closure of approved work shall be authorized with affected-participant notice and a disposition of dependencies, contributions, and remaining records.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each progression decision shall state the current and proposed stage, evaluate the relevant evidence, identify remaining limitations, and record approval, return for revision, deferral, or closure. A stage label shall not substitute for the decision record. No Standard shall skip public review or final approval by claiming that a prototype or pilot already establishes acceptance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall retain versioned drafts, a requirement-to-source and assessment map, an issue register, and substantive decision records identifying alternatives, selected direction, rationale, and affected artifacts. GR interpretation shall use relevant foundation manuscripts and preserve unresolved source differences; operational narrowing affecting architecture shall have an ADR.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: At committee review, named reviewers shall evaluate epistemic adequacy, practical usability, ethical and distributional effects, accessibility, preservation and protection, legal/institutional boundaries, and technical feasibility within declared competence. Missing expertise or evidence shall be reported and resolved, or the scope narrowed, before unsupported requirements advance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Pilot reports shall identify the tested versions, cases and negative cases, methods, participants' roles, failures, burdens, limitations, and resulting changes. Synthetic or author-operated tests shall be labelled accordingly. External institutional participation, access authority, independent validation, and legal validity shall not be inferred from a synthetic rehearsal.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The project lead shall assemble the entry and exit evidence specified in Annex A before requesting progression. The decision authority shall record its assessment of each applicable item, the evidence locator, responsible reviewer, result, and any required action. An inapplicable item shall have a scope-based reason; unperformed work or unavailable evidence shall not be recorded as fulfilled.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A Working Draft shall identify open design alternatives and any unresolved requirements or dependencies. A Committee Draft shall integrate the selected proposal, source rationale, assessment method, and issue disposition sufficiently for a reviewer who did not participate in authoring. Neither designation shall imply that open issues have disappeared merely because the document has been renumbered.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before public review, the chair shall verify that applicable requirements have identified conformance subjects and assessment methods, examples are distinguished from obligations, material pilot failures are visible, and unresolved issues are bounded. A requirement whose interpretation depends on unavailable material or an unsettled contradiction shall be revised, narrowed, or withheld from the proposed normative scope.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A coordinated package shall identify authoritative locations for shared requirements, exact dependency versions, change propagation responsibilities, and release sequencing. The responsible editors shall assess a material dependency change against affected scopes, tests, examples, and users before progressing any dependent release. Circular references shall not be used to conceal an unassigned obligation or unsupported conformance claim.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A meeting used for a consequential decision shall have prior notice, an agenda and accessible materials, an assigned chair, identified participants and capacities, declared conflicts, and a decision record. A person unable to attend shall have the declared asynchronous opportunity to contribute before the decision closes. Meeting attendance alone shall not replace the prescribed ballot, public review, or reply period.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The chair shall circulate a proposed decision record for correction of factual inaccuracies and attribute unresolved corrections before using it as progression evidence. An editorial correction to minutes shall not alter the decision taken; a proposed change to that decision shall use the relevant reconsideration or new-decision procedure. The register shall distinguish a proposal, recommendation, authorization, and completed action.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before opening public review, the chair shall freeze a uniquely identified draft and publish its scope, class, maturity, change summary, dependencies, known limitations, review questions, exact opening and closing times, submission routes, and intended treatment of commenter information. Required supporting material shall be accessible to reviewers under workable terms.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Public review shall remain open for at least 60 calendar days. The chair shall record outreach, access interruptions, and accommodation needs; a material access failure shall receive an extension sufficient to restore meaningful opportunity, with reasons and revised closing time published.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall accept comments in an accessible free-text route as well as any structured template. It shall assign a stable identifier, record the affected version or topic, requested change if supplied, receipt date, and disclosure preference, and acknowledge receipt within seven calendar days. A comment shall not be rejected solely for lacking technical drafting expertise.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall offer a protected route for justified confidential submissions and explain its access limits. The chair shall arrange competent consideration and publish a safe summary of the issue and disposition where possible. If essential grounds cannot be exposed sufficiently for fair review, the chair shall record the limitation and defer or narrow the affected decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The responsible review group shall give every in-scope comment a disposition of accepted, accepted with modification, not accepted, or deferred, with reasons and links to affected clauses or issues. Out-of-scope and duplicate comments shall retain identifiers and a reason or linked disposition. Deferral shall identify an owner, next action, and why the unresolved issue does not invalidate proposed progression.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The chair shall target initial dispositions within 30 calendar days after review closes. If that target cannot be met, the chair shall publish reasons, interim status, and a new target before it expires. A target extension shall not deem comments resolved. Commenters shall receive disposition notice and at least 30 calendar days to reply before final approval.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The chair shall assess each reply and record remaining disagreement. Late comments shall be logged with reasons for current-cycle consideration or later referral; a newly identified material safety, rights, or validity defect shall receive assessment before adoption regardless of receipt date.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A substantive post-review change shall undergo public re-review for at least 30 calendar days, showing the changed text, reasons, effects, and affected dependencies. The chair shall notify previous commenters and newly affected interests. A change that substantially alters the purpose, affected constituency, or conformance subject shall receive renewed scope approval and a full 60-day review.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Re-review shall permit comments on changed material and its consequences for unchanged clauses. Further substantive changes shall repeat the applicable review. Editorial changes shall be logged with a reason why meaning and conformance remain unchanged.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall maintain the comment and disposition register specified in Annex B. A combined response may address duplicate issues only if each original comment remains traceable and its distinct material grounds are considered. Splitting a submission into issues shall preserve the connection to its original meaning. Summary statistics shall not substitute for the disposition of an unresolved substantive concern.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A review closure record shall identify the exact closing time, submissions received, submissions awaiting acknowledgement or clarification, late submissions, access failures, extensions, and next steps. The chair shall distinguish closure of intake from completion of dispositions. The count of unresolved comments shall not become zero merely because the public submission window has closed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For each proposed disposition, the review group shall identify the responsible respondent, material evidence, affected requirements, reason, resulting text or decision, and review required by the change. A not-accepted disposition shall address the substantive grounds rather than rely solely on lack of votes, institutional rank, drafting inconvenience, or an unsupported assertion that the issue was already settled.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: If a submission includes conduct allegations or protected information together with a technical objection, the Secretariat shall separate access and handling while retaining a safe cross-reference. The technical issue shall continue to receive consideration unless a recorded reason requires a stay. Protected reporting shall not confer permission to publish personal details in the public disposition register.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When sending a disposition or re-review notice, the Secretariat shall record its intended recipients, authorized route, content version, dispatch time, and known delivery failures. Where a material failure prevents meaningful reply, the chair shall provide a workable alternative or extend the affected reply opportunity and record the resulting progression consequence. A failed delivery shall not be represented as silence by the recipient.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before recommending progression, the chair shall produce a consensus assessment identifying participation and gaps, objections, attempts at resolution, evidence and alternatives considered, remaining dissent, and reasons for the recommendation. Numerical approval shall not establish substantive truth or by itself dispose of an objection.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A sustained substantive objection shall receive reasoned consideration and an opportunity for reply. It shall not automatically confer a veto. Unresolved defects in mandatory procedure, decision authority, rights to participate, or required evidence shall prevent progression until remedied. Other remaining disagreement shall be visible in the approval package and assessed by the authorized decision maker.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For adoption, substantive maintenance decisions, and other decisions assigned a formal ballot by the Charter, the Secretariat shall circulate a frozen package and proposed resolution for at least 30 calendar days. It shall state eligible participants, recusals, closing time, threshold calculation, ballot options, and challenge route. Ballots shall be approve, disapprove, or abstain; nonresponse shall be recorded separately.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The eligible non-recused roster shall be fixed before ballot opening. Each eligible person shall have one ballot in their declared capacity; proxies and duplicate capacities shall not count. Eligibility corrections or later recusals shall be recorded. A change materially affecting the electorate, quorum, or result shall require a new ballot; membership shall not be manipulated to obtain a desired outcome.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Let $N$ be the number of eligible non-recused participants, $R$ valid returned ballots including abstentions, $Y$ approvals, and $D$ disapprovals. A ballot shall meet quorum only if $R\geq\lceil2N/3\rceil$. Approval shall also require at least three substantive ballots, $Y+D\geq3$, and $Y\geq\lceil2(Y+D)/3\rceil$. Abstentions shall count for returned-ballot quorum but not the substantive-ballot minimum or approval denominator; nonresponses shall count for neither.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The result shall include the frozen roster count, recusals, returned ballots, approvals, disapprovals, abstentions, nonresponses, calculation, minority grounds, and decision. Failure of quorum or threshold shall return the matter for further work or deferral, without deemed approval. A substantive change during ballot shall return to the applicable review stage.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Final approval shall require a procedurally valid ballot, reasoned consensus assessment, completed dispositions and reply periods, resolved blocking findings, compatible normative dependencies, rights clearance, maintenance assignment, and an authorized adoption record. The Secretariat shall publish accessible decision notice, notify participants and commenters, and record when the appeal period starts. Release shall await that period and resolution of any appeal affecting adoption or publication.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The ballot notice shall include the exact resolution, frozen text and associated artifacts, consensus assessment, dispositions, remaining objections, eligibility basis, and required calculation. The Secretariat shall provide each eligible person a means to submit one attributable ballot without disclosing unnecessary personal information and shall identify a neutral route for challenges to ballot administration.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A participant may replace their own ballot before the declared closing time; the Secretariat shall count only the latest valid submission and retain a protected audit of the replacement. An ambiguous or unverifiable submission shall receive a clarification request and shall not be silently converted to approval or abstention. Ballot validity decisions shall identify the rule applied and the available challenge route.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A ballot extension shall be announced before the original close, state the access or participation reason and new closing time, and apply equally to the eligible electorate. An extension shall not change the resolution or threshold or be used solely to solicit a desired result. A frozen package requiring substantive change shall be withdrawn from ballot and returned to applicable review.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A non-conflicted person other than the person compiling the tally shall verify eligibility counts, duplicate or replacement handling, recusals, arithmetic, and the consistency of the declared result with the frozen resolution. The verification record shall identify any unresolved discrepancy. A numerical pass with an unresolved blocking procedural finding shall not authorize adoption.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The adoption or release authorization shall identify the approved publication class and edition, resolution, vote result where required, consensus rationale, authority exercised, effective date, appeal notice, and conditions affecting release. The release owner shall distinguish this authorization from compilation, distribution, and commencement of an institution's use. An institution's uptake shall not be inferred from programme publication.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A participant, commenter, or person directly affected by a programme decision may lodge a procedural appeal identifying the decision, alleged procedural failure, available evidence, and requested remedy. Membership or payment shall not be a condition. The ordinary filing period shall be 30 calendar days after accessible notice of the decision; lack of effective notice or newly discovered concealed procedural failure shall permit a reasoned extension by the independent reviewer.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall acknowledge an appeal within seven calendar days and refer it to an appointed reviewer independent of the disputed decision. The reviewer shall disclose relevant involvement and interests, consider conflict objections, and record independence. The decision's author, a materially interested participant, or a person deciding a related complaint about their own conduct shall not determine the appeal.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The reviewer shall state scope, admissibility reasons, record access arrangements, and timetable; provide the appellant and responsible decision maker a meaningful opportunity to reply; and issue a reasoned determination. An initial determination shall be targeted within 30 calendar days of receipt, with reasoned extensions and updated dates notified before expiry. No response or elapsed time shall constitute rejection.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An appeal concerning adoption, public-review exclusion, or authority shall pause the affected publication decision. Other appeals shall receive a recorded decision on whether a stay is necessary to prevent prejudice. If no independent reviewer is available, consequential contested progression shall remain pending while unaffected work continues.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The reviewer may uphold the process, require disclosure or correction of records, set aside a procedurally defective decision, or remit the matter for renewed participation, review, or ballot. The reviewer shall not substitute a ruling on factual truth, external legal entitlement, or technical merit for procedural review. The accountable body shall record implementation of the remedy before renewed progression.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Technical reconsideration, conduct complaints, record-specific access or correction requests, and external legal remedies shall have distinguishable routes. Misrouted submissions shall receive assisted referral rather than silent rejection. Protected conduct handling shall follow the adopted ethics policy; disagreement alone shall not be treated as misconduct. Internal review shall not be presented as replacing external rights or remedies.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An appeal record shall identify the challenged decision, appellant or protected reference, grounds, requested remedy, receipt and notice dates, admissibility assessment, appointed reviewer, disclosed conflicts, participation opportunities, stay status, outcome, reasons, and implementation responsibility. Refusal to admit an appeal shall receive reasons and the same independence safeguards as a determination on its merits.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The reviewer shall distinguish an objection to the substantive proposal from an allegation that the operative process was not followed. A submission containing both shall receive coordinated handling without forcing the appellant to abandon either ground. A procedural remedy shall identify which decision or stage is affected and what evidence is required before the stay can be lifted.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A protected appeal shall give each affected party sufficient grounds and opportunity to respond for the determination being made. If disclosure limits prevent fair determination, the reviewer shall narrow the finding, obtain an authorized independent examination, or defer with stated reasons. Confidentiality shall not be described as proof that the undisclosed account is correct.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall track implementation of an appeal remedy and provide the appellant with its status through the permitted route. A remitted decision shall cite the appeal and demonstrate completion of the required reconsideration or repeated stage. Closing the appeal file shall not establish that a correction, new review, or practical remedy has been completed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The release owner shall verify that the exact publication package implements the approved text and decision. The package shall identify edition, date, class, maturity, adoption authority, conformance scope, dependencies, licenses or permissions, known limitations, maintenance contact, next review date, and superseded publications where applicable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The release manifest shall identify authoritative source files, rendered publications, schemas or fixtures where included, their versions and integrity checks, build instructions and tool versions, and the approval record. A reviewer other than the final editor shall compare the rendered output with the approved source for omitted, altered, or unreadable requirements and record the result.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The release owner shall resolve source/build discrepancies before release. Source corrections affecting meaning shall return to substantive review; a rebuild shall not silently change an adopted requirement. Public notices shall distinguish an adopted Standard, a Specification, an informative publication, and a policy recommendation and shall not claim ungranted endorsement or certification.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before release, the owner shall complete the release register in Annex B, including dependency availability, permission basis, source/render verification, accessibility limitations, unresolved issues, appeal status, distribution locations, and withdrawal contact. A dependency that is unavailable on usable terms shall trigger scope revision or deferral rather than an unsupported interoperability claim.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A corrected build or accessible alternative representation shall identify its relationship to the approved edition and whether substantive content is unchanged. Where two representations disagree, the owner shall issue a notice, determine the approved content from the decision record, and correct the affected artifacts under the applicable change procedure. A hidden preference for the newest file shall not resolve normative disagreement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Every release shall have an assigned maintenance owner, issue intake route, and next review date. The default review interval shall be two years, shortened by a recorded risk-based decision. Loss of ownership, serious defects, changed dependencies, inaccessible implementation rights, or evidence of material exclusion or harm shall trigger earlier review. An overdue review shall be publicly marked and escalated; silence shall not confirm continued suitability.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The maintenance owner shall log reported issues, classify their effect, identify affected versions and dependencies, and publish disposition or investigation status. A correction request shall not be rejected merely because the reported behavior matches the current text.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A corrigendum shall correct an error without introducing a new obligation, altering intended meaning, or changing a valid conformance outcome. It shall identify the affected text, corrected text, justification, reviewer, and authorization. If semantic effect is uncertain, the change shall use the amendment or revision route. Historical publications shall remain identifiable rather than silently overwritten.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An amendment shall make a bounded substantive change to a named edition; a revision shall issue a consolidated new edition. Both shall receive scope approval, assessment of dependent artifacts and users, appropriate pilots, committee and public review, and final approval under these Directives. An incompatible change shall include migration, coexistence, and deprecation information without claiming lossless conversion absent evidence.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Periodic review shall invite evidence from users and affected parties and record confirmation, correction, amendment, revision, supersession, or withdrawal with reasons. Confirmation shall require a maintenance report and an authorized decision; it shall not erase known limitations.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Proposed withdrawal or supersession shall receive a public notice of reasons, dependencies, transition consequences, and alternatives for at least 60 calendar days, followed by comment disposition, reply, and formal approval. Withdrawn editions shall remain identifiable with status and date; withdrawal shall not retroactively change what a past conformance claim asserted. Necessary protection of underlying records shall follow D1-052, D1-053, and EIP-039.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An issue assessment shall distinguish editorial error, conflicting requirements, implementation defect, changed external dependency, emerging misuse or harm, accessibility failure, and proposed new scope. The maintenance owner shall state the affected editions, current mitigation, evidence required, accountable next action, and review date. Classification shall be reconsidered when new evidence changes the issue's substantive effect.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A proposed corrigendum shall be reviewed by a person other than its editor against examples and known conformance outcomes material to the correction. If the parties disagree whether meaning changes, the owner shall preserve the disagreement and use substantive review unless the uncertainty is resolved with recorded grounds. Issuing a corrected file shall not erase the original published error and its applicability interval.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An amendment or revision proposal shall assess current users, dependencies, historical records, version negotiation, migration losses, and coexistence needs. The approval record shall distinguish prospective requirements from statements about previous editions. A deprecated feature shall have a reason, affected scope, intended alternative, and transition notice; deprecation alone shall not retroactively change an earlier conformance result.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A confirmation decision shall identify the review evidence, known limitations, current maintenance capacity, dependency status, and next review date. If review cannot establish continued suitability, the authority shall select further investigation, narrowing, revision, suspension of programme recommendations, or withdrawal rather than confirm by default. A dormant publication shall remain findable with its actual status.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An authorized governance or release holder may issue a time-limited warning or suspend programme distribution or programme recommendations for new use where a documented serious protection, rights, or integrity risk requires immediate action. The action shall state evidence, scope, authority, duration, contact, affected users, and safe public reasons. It shall remain within programme authority and shall not create or amend normative requirements or purport to invalidate external legal decisions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Emergency action shall receive independent review within seven calendar days and expire within 30 calendar days unless the governance authority records a justified extension, next review date, and remedy plan. Unavailable independent capacity shall not authorize emergency adoption. Permanent amendment or withdrawal shall follow the ordinary procedure; protective handling of unlawfully or improperly disclosed material remains governed by the applicable policy and context.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A vacant role shall trigger recorded reassignment within the Charter's mandate or deferral of dependent decisions. A temporary substitute shall meet the same conflict and independence conditions. Emergency procedure shall not be used to avoid consultation because ordinary development is late or under-resourced.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The owner of an emergency action shall maintain an incident record identifying the triggering evidence, protection decision, consultations, users notified, independent review, expiry or extension, and restoration criteria. At closure, the governance authority shall assess whether ordinary maintenance, a procedural amendment, or further support is needed and publish permitted reasons. Repetition of temporary measures shall not conceal an unresolved need for substantive review.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall preserve linked proposal, draft, comment, disposition, decision, ballot-result, appeal-outcome, release, and maintenance records. Public readers shall be able to follow the grounds and changes of a decision without mandatory access to private correspondence. Record corrections shall retain the prior account and correction relationship where lawful and appropriate.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A records schedule shall state purpose, custodian, access category, retention period or trigger, restriction review, and authorized disposition for each record category. Public publication history and safe decision reasons shall be retained durably; sensitive submissions and personal data shall not be retained indefinitely by default. A restriction or deletion shall preserve a safe explanation when permitted, without revealing protected existence or identity.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The governance authority shall publish an annual account of active work, decisions, unresolved objections, participation gaps, funding influence, overdue maintenance, and procedural incidents at a level that protects affected people. The account shall distinguish claimed representation from evidenced participation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: External liaison shall have an explicit mandate identifying purpose, authorized speaker, commitments permitted, and reporting duties. A policy proposal shall identify its intended institution and review route and remain recommendatory. Liaison, use of external sources, and informal participation shall not imply affiliation, institutional endorsement, or adoption of another body's procedures.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before external release of a Specification or informative publication, the responsible authority shall approve a work-item review plan identifying publication class, maturity criteria, release authority, reviewers and needed competence, public-comment arrangements and period with rationale, objection disposition, appeal route, maintenance responsibility and rights clearance. The release record shall identify fulfillment and remaining limitations. Drafting alone shall not constitute that approval.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A Specification release containing technical conformance requirements shall use the technical review, public review, disposition, ballot and appeal rules in this Part, while retaining Specification status and its declared maturity. Its release shall not use stage 60 or imply Standard adoption. Promotion shall require an explicit Standard work-item and adoption decision with review of changed scope, requirements and prior evidence.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A Policy or Institutional Proposal shall receive a separate mandate-specific release decision identifying its intended addressee, institutional and affected-interest review, public-comment opportunity, considered alternatives and unresolved objections. Its review plan shall preserve a reasoned disposition and the procedural appeal route in this Part. An informative report or manual shall likewise identify its review and release decision without claiming technical Standard conformance authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An assessment against these Directives shall identify the procedure, project and decisions covered, operative or rehearsal editions, assessor and relationship, methods, evidence, and results for every applicable requirement. Documentary checks and observation of performed procedures shall be distinguished. An unobserved action shall remain not assessed when only a designed form or hypothetical record is available.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The governance authority shall review procedural failures and participant feedback for recurring barriers, delay, concentrated influence, unavailable remedies, or unmanageable burden. The review shall identify corrective actions, owners, and follow-up evidence. A procedural amendment shall itself follow the Charter's review and transition rules and shall not retrospectively validate a defective decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The stage dossier shall identify each scheduled evidence item, its location and version, custodian, access limitations, assessment result, and unresolved action. An item may be reused from an earlier stage when the responsible reviewer confirms that its scope and evidence remain applicable. Reuse shall not imply that a later change has been reviewed when it has not.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Every notice governed by a period in Table~\ref{tab:d1-periods} shall state the starting event, time zone, closing timestamp, responsible function, extension rule, and next route if the period is missed. The period shall be measured from effective accessible notice or the specified receipt event. A changed closing time shall remain traceable to the prior notice and its reason.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A missed acknowledgement or target date shall remain visible as a procedural event with reason, effect, corrective action, and notice to permitted recipients. An extension shall not erase the missed service obligation or cure exclusion retrospectively. An unresolved failure material to fair consideration shall prevent dependent progression until remedied.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The Secretariat shall maintain the registers in Table~\ref{tab:d1-registers} for applicable activities. Each record shall have a distinguishable reference, version or correction relationship, responsible custodian, creation time, and permitted access scope. A shared register may satisfy several functions if each required distinction remains retrievable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A public decision view shall preserve enough permitted information to identify the issue, authority, reasons, outcome, status, and challenge route. An authorized assessor shall be able to locate the underlying protected record when their mandate permits. A restriction that prevents assessment shall produce a stated assessment limitation rather than a presumed pass.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For coordinated assessment of this edition, the editor shall apply CH-010 and CH-011 to the publication-class and Standard-status statements required by D2-001 to D2-003; the applicable D1-040 to D1-048 provisions and the identified stage-specific procedure to the publication and change-control subjects invoked by D2-042 to D2-045; and EIP-028 to EIP-031 and EIP-039 to incorporated source material, intended distribution and protected case information where present. The dependency record shall identify the provisions triggered, exact editions, source locators and evidence.
