An unavailable or incompatible dependency shall leave the affected result not assessed pending resolution.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A publication shall identify its code or other identifier, title, publication class, maturity status, version, responsible editor or unassigned responsibility, and source location near its beginning.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A draft shall state that it is not adopted and shall distinguish authoring progress from formally authorized project status. A publication shall not imply ISO, IEC, IEEE or governmental authority without a documented basis.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A revision shall identify the preceding edition and summarize substantive changes. The publication package shall preserve a retrievable change relationship and the status of the earlier edition. A new rendering of unchanged text shall not be represented as a new normative decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An editor shall assign one principal publication class and state its intended readers, use and authority. A Standard, Specification, Technical Report, Manual, governance document and Policy or Institutional Proposal shall not be treated as interchangeable classes.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A protocol description shall identify its containing publication class. Protocol behavior shall be distinguished from the institutional authority and procedure under which that behavior is used.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A Policy or Institutional Proposal shall distinguish factual background, interpretation, objectives, options, mandate, implementation implications and unresolved questions. It shall not create technical conformance obligations through an unapproved policy recommendation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A document containing material of more than one publication class shall identify the principal class and separate the subsidiary material by a stated structural boundary. The editor shall state whether each part defines requirements, supplies guidance or proposes an institutional option.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The scope shall identify the subject of conformance, intended use, relevant environment and exclusions. A claim of conformance shall be assessable within that stated boundary.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Normative and informative material shall be distinguishable at clause, annex or artifact level. Notes, examples and informative annexes shall not introduce additional requirements.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Every table, figure, annex and associated artifact shall have a stated role and, where interpretation depends on it, a stated authority status. A normative requirement represented in a diagram shall also have an identifiable textual formulation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A technical or governance draft prepared under this document shall contain a title and status statement, a foreword, a scope clause, a normative-reference clause, a terms-and-definitions clause, substantive provisions and an assessment or application clause. It shall identify the role of every annex and associated artifact. An informative bibliography shall be provided when informative external sources are cited.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The foreword shall record publication history, responsible preparation and material edition changes without introducing technical requirements. The introduction, when present, shall explain the problem, approach and intended use without creating additional conformance obligations.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The scope shall identify both inclusions and material exclusions. It shall not contain requirements that can be located only in the scope or imply applicability to environments for which the document supplies no assessment basis.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall assign decimal clause and subclause numbers, use descriptive titles and place substantive text at an identifiable leaf of the hierarchy. If a clause has subclauses, introductory provisions belonging to that clause shall be placed in a General subclause or another identified subclause.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A cross-reference shall identify a stable requirement, clause, table, figure or annex as appropriate. References such as above, below, elsewhere or the latest text shall not be the sole locator of content necessary for interpretation or assessment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A requirement shall identify the responsible actor or object, the applicable condition, the required behavior or property, and an outcome or evidence by which fulfillment can be assessed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A requirement shall use a stable identifier independent of its displayed section number. An identifier shall not be reassigned to a different obligation after circulation; a withdrawn identifier shall remain traceable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A requirement shall not combine independent obligations whose applicability or assessment differs so materially that one result would conceal another. Related obligations can be grouped when their joint assessment is explicit.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Terms such as adequate, appropriate, trustworthy or significant shall have a scoped criterion, declared decision responsibility or assessment procedure when they determine conformance. A broad aspiration alone shall not be presented as a testable requirement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each requirement shall be linked to at least one discriminating assessment question. The question shall distinguish an acceptable outcome from a materially different outcome that would not fulfill the requirement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where one identifier groups related obligations, the assessment schedule shall identify the components and record a result for each materially distinct component. Fulfillment of one component shall not conceal an unassessed or failed component.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall distinguish mandatory conditions, recommendations, permissions and capability statements consistently. A recommendation's non-fulfillment shall not be reported as failure of a requirement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall use shall and shall not for requirements and prohibitions, should and should not for recommendations, may for permission, and can for possibility or capability. Must shall not be used as an alternative requirement verb in programme-authored provisions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A statement of external necessity, including a stated legal constraint, shall identify its source and context. The editor shall distinguish that external constraint from an obligation created by the publication.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A permission shall not override a requirement implicitly. Exceptions shall identify the affected obligation, conditions, authority, required record and any limitation on the resulting conformance claim.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A conditional requirement shall state its trigger and how applicability is determined. A result of not applicable shall include its reason; it shall not substitute for unavailable evidence or an unperformed assessment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When complete information is not realistically available, a recording requirement shall specify whether a justified unknown, limitation or restricted disclosure satisfies the obligation. It shall not require invented content to complete a mandatory field.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A provision permitting an unknown value, unavailable source or restricted disclosure shall state the required declaration, responsible role and assessment consequence. The editor shall distinguish fulfillment of that declaration requirement from resolution of the underlying factual question.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An exception shall state its eligibility condition, decision authority, permitted departure, duration or review trigger, required evidence and effect on the resulting claim of fulfillment. An exception shall not be implied solely by a resource limitation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For each substantive topic in scope, the editor shall identify normal operation, material boundary cases, failure conditions and applicable interfaces. A topic shall not be treated as specified solely because it appears in a list of objectives.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where requirements can impose material recording, review or participation burdens, the document shall identify the intended operating scale and the evidence needed to assess that burden. A reduced profile shall state its limitations and shall not silently claim the coverage of the parent document.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An operational definition shall state its scope and shall not imply that it exhausts a broader philosophical concept. A definition imported or adapted from a source shall identify that source, edition and the nature of the adaptation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A definition entry shall identify the preferred term, a unique term locator, the relevant domain where needed, and a definition that distinguishes the concept from adjacent concepts. Notes and examples shall remain separate from the definition.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall use a defined term consistently within its declared scope. A synonym, abbreviated term, deprecated term or narrower profile-specific use shall be identified explicitly rather than introduced as an unexplained substitution.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A draft shall distinguish occurrence claims, observations, evidence assessments, interpretations, normative evaluations, legal assertions and institutional determinations wherever conflation would strengthen a claim beyond its grounds or authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For a substantive GR definition, the editor shall record the relevant foundation passage, alternatives, unresolved differences and the rationale for operational use. A material narrowing or departure shall have an Architecture Decision Record before the definition is stabilized for adoption.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An operational definition of Entity, State, Event, Process, Relation or Property shall address admissibility, identity, temporal behavior, allowed relations, required and optional information, examples, counterexamples and unresolved edge cases. A declaration that an item remains provisional shall identify the missing decisions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall not equate a formal state with an archival State, a mechanism with a Process, or formal change with an Event without an explicit argument and scoped decision. The six record roles shall not be presented as exhaustive constituents of reality.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A source trace for a GR-specific operational definition shall identify the manuscript version, passage locator, interpreted distinction, operational narrowing, material alternative and affected provision. A source discrepancy shall remain visible until its disposition is recorded.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A translation or cross-vocabulary mapping used to determine conformance shall identify the source and target editions, responsible reviewer, correspondence asserted and known non-equivalences. An untranslated or unmapped distinction shall not be represented as preserved without supporting evidence.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An external reference used to support a normative or scholarly claim shall be verified against an identified primary source. Inaccessible text, uncertain edition, incomplete review and unverified compatibility shall be identified rather than reconstructed as fact.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A normative reference shall identify the exact document and edition required to apply a requirement, the part relied on and a means of obtaining it. Informative motivation shall be listed separately from normative dependencies.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each normative reference shall be invoked by an identifiable requirement or application rule. The dependency record shall state the incorporated scope, required edition and assessment consequence of an unavailable or incompatible dependency.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A draft depending on another draft shall identify the dependency's version and status and the consequences of a change. It shall not imply the dependency has already been adopted.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A bibliography entry shall provide enough information to distinguish the cited source and locate the relevant edition. Where an external model is used for drafting or comparison, the source record shall distinguish directly inspected material from catalogue metadata, secondary description and unavailable text.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before approval for publication, the editor shall produce a dependency review identifying incompatible versions, unavailable dependencies, circular requirements and licensing or access constraints material to implementation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A material dependency change shall identify affected requirements, definitions, assessment cases and associated artifacts. The editor shall record whether each affected element remains valid, requires revision or cannot yet be assessed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A draft shall state the limits of its conformance claims, including the distinction between record structure and factual truth, between source authentication and evidential warrant, and between technical conformance and legal or ethical judgment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A claim of equivalence, compatibility or interoperability with another model shall identify its direction, scope, tested cases, unsupported distinctions and known loss. Matching terminology alone shall not justify that claim.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The conformance clause shall distinguish the assessed subject, publication edition, profile, applicable requirements, assessment method, assessor and result. It shall distinguish a record, producer, protocol participant, presentation, archive and organizational procedure when their obligations differ.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A document allowing more than one conformance subject shall specify the requirement set applicable to each subject or state that the available assessment is partial. It shall distinguish examination of a record from observation of the practice or procedure represented by that record.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An automated check shall identify the constraints it actually assesses. A passing automated result shall not be presented as evidence of a human or institutional action that the check did not observe.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each requirement shall have at least one stated assessment method and evidence expectation. Structural checks, protocol tests, human interpretation and procedural review shall have separately identifiable results.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A conformance report shall distinguish fulfilled, not fulfilled, not assessed and not applicable results. A missing assessment shall not be counted as fulfillment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An assessment method shall specify its objective, input conditions, procedure, relevant tools or competence, expected observations, result rule and material limitations. The method shall identify the conditions under which an inconclusive or not-assessed result is required.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An assessment report shall retain failed and unassessed applicable requirements and their effect on the overall result. A summary shall not replace the underlying requirement-level evidence register.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A profile shall state its parent requirements, additions, permitted restrictions, exclusions and intended users. It shall not silently weaken a parent requirement while claiming unqualified parent conformance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For an optional capability, a document shall state the condition under which associated obligations become mandatory. An implementation selecting that capability shall be assessed against the complete selected requirement set.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A schema, API or encoding choice shall be traceable to a stated requirement or interoperability need. Implementation convenience alone shall not be described as a philosophical necessity or universal institutional rule.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A data dictionary shall distinguish semantic information requirements from serialization names, storage types and transport behavior. Each mandatory or conditional element shall identify its meaning, applicable subject and permitted absent or unknown states.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A protocol Specification shall define its participants, inputs, preconditions, state transitions, observable outputs, effects, refusal and failure cases, recovery behavior, version assumptions and authorization boundaries.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An artifact package shall identify the relationship between its prose requirements and its schemas, examples, vocabularies, test fixtures and executable components. Conflicts shall have a documented resolution rule that does not silently amend an approved requirement.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A protocol description shall distinguish sending, transport delivery, receipt, acknowledgment, acceptance for processing and substantive disposition when those states have different consequences. A transport success shall not imply institutional acceptance or completion of a remedy.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where concurrent updates or repeated messages are in scope, the protocol description shall specify correlation, version preconditions, duplicate handling, conflict disposition and recovery after interruption. If those behaviors are not specified, the interoperability claim shall identify that exclusion.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Executable validation or rendering shall not silently retrieve unpinned remote resources, disclose protected input or substitute a current external vocabulary for the edition declared in the package. Any required external processing shall be explicit.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Examples intended to be valid shall identify the supported profile and expected result. Negative examples shall identify the intended defect. Synthetic evidence shall be labelled as synthetic.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each associated schema, vocabulary, executable example or test fixture shall identify its owner, version, publication class or role, controlling requirements and status. Its release manifest shall state whether the artifact is normative, informative or experimental.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A discrepancy between prose and an associated artifact shall be recorded with affected conformance outcomes. The release package shall identify the controlling interpretation or remain pending resolution; implementers shall not be required to infer priority from file format.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Every substantive table and figure shall have a unique number, descriptive caption and an explicit reference or structural purpose in the surrounding text. Required information shall not be encoded solely by colour, shape or visual position.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A formula used in a requirement or assessment method shall identify its variables, domain, units where applicable, assumptions and interpretation. Undefined quantities and unsupported numerical precision shall remain explicit limitations.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A publication shall use headings, table labels, link text and readable typography that expose its structure. Essential meaning shall not depend solely on color, visual position or a diagram.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An editor shall provide a usable source or alternative reading representation and identify known accessibility limitations of the rendered document. Successful PDF compilation alone shall not establish accessibility conformance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An example shall state whether it is synthetic, adapted or empirical and identify any omitted material that affects its use. Expected behavior in an authored scenario shall remain distinguishable from observed behavior in an executed assessment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The publication assessment shall identify intended reading modes, known barriers and the evidence used to assess accessibility. Availability of source text, PDF text extraction or a successful build shall not alone establish accessibility conformance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A legal or institutional assertion used in a requirement shall identify the context, asserted source of authority and scope. A proposed model rule or policy option shall be labelled as such rather than described as generally applicable law.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall record cross-domain review findings relevant to scope, including epistemic, ethical, legal, institutional, political-economy, archival, security and accessibility questions. Unavailable competence or unresolved material objections shall remain visible in progression records.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A policy or institutional recommendation shall identify the intended decision maker, asserted mandate, feasible alternatives, implementation conditions, affected interests and evaluation approach. Adoption of a technical requirement shall not be presented as resolving those policy choices automatically.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each circulated edition shall identify its canonical source and rendered artifacts. Changes to proposed requirements shall be traceable through the change record, with superseded reasoning retained subject to justified access and retention rules.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A release candidate shall be built from the declared source revision, with build instructions, required tooling and an artifact manifest sufficient to reproduce and compare its substantive content.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The release check shall detect broken internal references, duplicate requirement identifiers, missing glyphs, visibly clipped material, mismatched status labels and disagreement between declared source and generated artifact. Unresolved defects shall be reported with their effect on use.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall distinguish the canonical authoring source, any generated representation and the exact edition submitted for decision. A release manifest shall identify source and artifact integrity references, build instructions, tool versions and the associated review record.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An editorial correction shall not silently change the substance of a requirement. A substantive change to an adopted normative edition shall use the amendment or revision procedure in Directives Part 1, including affected-artifact and compatibility review. A draft change shall follow the change-control and re-review rules applicable to its current stage. Changes to a released Specification shall follow its declared maintenance procedure and promotion shall require a separate decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A changed requirement shall retain its identifier when its continuity is defensible and identify the nature of the change. A withdrawn requirement shall remain traceable. Reorganization shall provide a correspondence map when clause numbering or placement changes materially.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An archival source snapshot shall record the source set, edition and integrity references. A historical snapshot shall be marked as historical and shall not replace the current edition's status or dependency declarations.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessor shall identify the publication package, assessed edition, applicable structural profile, assessment scope, assessor relationship and required competence before issuing an overall result. Missing expertise and unavailable artifacts shall be reported.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessment shall use the record specified in Annex~\ref{ann:assessment} and examine the structural schedule in Annex~\ref{ann:structure}. Each applicable requirement shall receive an individual supported result.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A finding shall identify the affected provision or artifact, the observed defect, its effect on interpretation or assessment, the proposed disposition and the responsible action. A correction shall identify the revised edition and the evidence used to close the finding.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An overall publication result shall distinguish structural checks, technical review, source interpretation, cross-domain assessment and authorization for release. Fulfillment of one category shall not be reported as fulfillment of an unperformed category.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall apply the structural schedule in Table~\ref{tab:structure} according to the declared publication class. A departure shall identify its rationale, alternative location and effect on assessment. The schedule shall not require an empty clause to simulate completeness.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before submission for final approval, the package review shall determine whether each in-scope topic has a defined subject, required behavior or outcome, applicability rule and assessment basis. An unresolved topic shall be excluded explicitly, retained as an open issue preventing the affected claim, or returned for development.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessment record shall include the information specified in Table~\ref{tab:assessment-record}. Protected evidence shall be referenced through a permitted locator and its examination limits shall remain explicit.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Fulfilled shall be reported only when the stated assessment method and evidence support the applicable obligation. Not applicable shall identify an absent trigger. Unavailable evidence or an unperformed assessment shall be reported as not assessed unless another specified result rule applies.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An unqualified claim of fulfillment of the declared publication profile shall not be issued while an applicable requirement is not fulfilled or not assessed. A partial result shall identify the assessed subset and excluded conclusions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An assessment of this document or a publication prepared under it shall apply the topical checks in Table~\ref{tab:d2-self-assessment} to every applicable D2 requirement, using the record in Annex~\ref{ann:assessment}. Each requirement and each materially distinct grouped component shall receive its own result and evidence. A grouped table row shall not authorize one undifferentiated result for its identifiers.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The convenor shall record the governance editions applicable to committee work and identify unresolved conflicts before dependent action. A new draft or external source shall not change an operative committee obligation by implication.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall become active only through a recorded mandate under the adopted programme Charter. The mandate shall identify its convenor, responsible decision authority, participating capacities, accepted work items, review resources, and mandate review date.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall develop coordinated recording and practical procedures that support warranted, contestable, revisable recognition and preservation of consequential generative trajectories. Each accepted work item shall state its contribution to this purpose and the limits of its expected effects.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Committee work shall distinguish changes in the situation under inquiry, changes in evidence and judgment, and changes in categories or methods of recognition. A technical representation connecting these histories shall preserve their distinguishable meaning.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall retain the distinctions between theoretical metamodel, operational record ontology, epistemic representation, normative assessment, jurisprudential status, institutional governance, political economy, and implementation when defining scopes or allocating work.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall not claim authority to certify substantive historical truth, resolve a complete metaphysics, determine legal rights across jurisdictions, endorse a political choice on technical grounds alone, or mandate unrestricted disclosure of recorded material.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall preserve existing publication identifiers when refining scopes. A proposal to change a publication's class, merge or divide its scope, or introduce a new identifier shall record the reason, dependencies, alternatives, and authorizing decision before the change is treated as operative.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A work-item proposal shall identify purpose, scope and exclusions, conformance subjects, affected interests, foundation sources and tensions, existing alternatives, related publications, anticipated Specifications, reviewer competence, practical evidence, and maintenance ownership.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A proposed substantive scope expansion shall return to the responsible decision authority with its consequences for participation, sources, dependencies, review, and resources. Work outside the authorized scope shall remain exploratory pending a decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: On acceptance of a work item, the convenor shall create a project record linking the authorized proposal, actual decision, bounded outputs, accepted assignments, resources, milestones, dependencies, and unresolved conditions. The record shall distinguish preliminary drafting already performed from work formally authorized.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before scheduling a progression review, the convenor shall verify that the work remains within its mandate, that required responsibilities are staffed, and that necessary evidence is available. A scope or capacity defect shall receive correction, narrowing, or deferral rather than an unsupported stage label.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall record work-item dependencies and allocate requirements to their responsible publication before producing a normative technical binding. A shared requirement shall have one authoritative location, with versioned references from dependent work.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Editors shall begin with the normative or procedural need and create a Specification proposal when reusable infrastructure is required to satisfy or assess it. A prototype shall not silently determine a theoretical definition or institutional obligation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall maintain a dependency register identifying each shared concept, requirement, interface, profile, or artifact; its responsible publication and owner; its exact version; and the consequence of change. Competing normative homes shall be resolved before the affected requirement is stabilized.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For a coordination issue, the convenor shall identify affected editors and reviewers, record alternatives and semantic or institutional consequences, and seek an explicit decision within the appropriate authority. Technical convenience shall not resolve a normative, legal, or theoretical disagreement without that decision.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A split, merger, pause, or termination of a work item shall identify the fate of requirement identifiers, comments, evidence, responsibilities, dependencies, and publication expectations. The programme decision authority shall authorize the revised scope before dependent formal progression.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A Specification proposal shall identify the candidate requirement it supports, the need for a reusable technical contract, implementation alternatives, version assumptions, and the evidence expected from a prototype. An institutional procedure shall identify its actual authority separately from protocol mechanics.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before treating a protocol draft as ready for implementation, its editor shall define participants, inputs, preconditions, state transitions, observable outcomes, refusals, failures, recovery, authorization boundaries, and responsibility for interrupted or conflicting operations. Unresolved behavior shall be marked and excluded from unsupported completeness claims.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For each active deliverable, the committee shall record an accepted editor or lead, a maintenance contact, required review competence, available reviewers, and unfilled roles. Multiple roles held by one person shall be declared.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A new working group shall have a bounded scope, actual willing participants, an accountable lead, dependencies, intended outputs, and review or closure conditions. Its formation shall not imply autonomous adoption authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A reviewer shall identify the domain and scope of their assessment, relevant competence or situated knowledge, interests, material limitations, and whether they contributed to the material reviewed. A self-review shall not be labelled independent.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where required expertise or affected perspectives are unavailable, the committee shall record the gap and its material effect on progression. It shall narrow claims, seek additional review, or defer the affected decision when the gap prevents a justified assessment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An editor shall accept responsibility for the deliverable's current baseline, change record, source and requirement trace, pending comments, and progression evidence. A reviewer shall accept a bounded assessment assignment rather than an unspecified endorsement of the entire publication.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The convenor shall compare each work item's planned drafting, review, accessibility, protection, and maintenance tasks with actual participant capacity. A shortage affecting mandatory evidence or a safeguard shall change the schedule or scope and be reported to the programme decision authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For a substantive committee discussion, the convenor shall circulate the purpose, input versions, questions, expected output, access arrangements, and route for asynchronous contributions before the decision is taken. Participants unable to attend shall have the applicable opportunity to contribute under Directives Part 1.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The discussion record shall distinguish persons present from represented institutions, information reported from findings accepted, and recommendations from authorized decisions. Material reasons, alternatives, objections, actions, owners, and affected baseline versions shall be recorded.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where new material changes the basis of a proposed decision during a meeting, the chair shall identify the change and apply the relevant further-review procedure. Attendance or an informal show of support shall not replace required notice, reply, or ballot.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An editor or working-group handover shall provide the current baseline, requirement and source registers, unresolved comments and findings, dependencies, permissions, build or assessment instructions, and pending deadlines. The convenor shall verify receipt and record any gap before further reliance on the work.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A working group that has no accepted lead or capacity to discharge its mandate shall be reported as inactive or pending reassignment. Its outputs shall retain their actual maturity, and unfinished responsibilities shall be reassigned or explicitly deferred.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before introducing or materially changing a GR definition, notation, ontology class, or compatibility claim, the responsible editor shall examine the relevant foundation manuscripts and record exact source locations, terminology, scope, historical differences, and the proposed operational translation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall preserve unresolved foundation differences rather than harmonizing them silently. A material operational narrowing or departure shall be recorded through an architectural decision with alternatives, rationale, affected publications, and remaining uncertainty.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A candidate record-class definition shall identify its definition, admissibility conditions, identity criterion, temporal behavior, permitted relations, required and optional metadata, examples, counterexamples, and unresolved edge cases, or explicitly identify which elements remain under development.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An external compatibility or reuse proposal shall identify the exact source and edition, verified relevant provisions, mapping assumptions, exclusions, and evidence needed to support the claimed relationship. Similar terminology shall not alone establish equivalence.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The source register shall distinguish source wording, editorial paraphrase, historical variant, operational proposal, and accepted programme decision. Each material interpretation shall identify the relevant passage and version, verification status, and unresolved difference.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When a source is revised, newly available, or found to have been misinterpreted, the editor shall identify affected definitions and requirements, assess the consequence, and submit necessary changes through the appropriate procedure. Earlier interpretations and the reason for revision shall remain traceable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For each candidate requirement, the editor shall identify the responsible actor or subject, applicability condition, required outcome, assessment method, evidence expectation, source or operational rationale, and related issue or decision. A requirement with unresolved scope or testability shall retain a visible development issue.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall separate independently assessable obligations where one result would conceal different applicability or failure. Recommendations, examples, and explanatory theory shall remain distinguishable from mandatory provisions.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before stabilizing a requirement baseline, the review group shall examine examples, counterexamples, unknown or unavailable information, restricted records, and relevant conflicting interpretations. Required uncertainty declarations shall not be replaced by invented information to complete a record.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A conformance proposal shall identify the assessed subject, edition, profile, applicable requirements, methods, evidence, unresolved findings, and limits of the resulting claim. Syntax checks, semantic interoperability, procedural compliance, usability, and substantive warrant shall receive distinguishable results.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall substantiate an interoperability claim with independent implementation or exchange evidence appropriate to the claim. A single internally consistent prototype shall be reported as such.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The requirement-to-assessment register shall identify which findings arise from automated checks, observed human tasks, documentary review, independent implementation, or substantive expert judgment. The reported result shall not claim evidence beyond what the chosen method establishes.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A proposed profile shall identify inherited requirements, additions, permitted restrictions, applicability, and assessment consequences. The editor shall identify any divergence that prevents unqualified parent conformance and propose an appropriately bounded claim.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An asserted external mapping shall identify direction, supported distinctions, unsupported cases, loss, and the exact tested source versions. An untested mapping shall be labelled proposed rather than interoperable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: At work-item scoping, before a real pilot, and before publication progression, the committee shall maintain a review dossier covering applicable epistemic, ethical, jurisprudential, institutional, political-economic, archival, privacy/security, accessibility, and technical questions. Each domain shall have findings or an explicit justified statement of non-applicability or unassessed scope.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The review dossier shall identify evidence, reviewers and their capacities, affected perspectives, conflicts, alternative designs, findings, dispositions, owners of corrective action, and residual limitations. A metadata field or completed checklist shall not by itself count as domain assessment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The review plan shall state the questions, needed competence and affected perspectives, evidence, review independence sought, access arrangements, and decision points for each applicable domain. It shall distinguish non-applicability from unavailable review capacity.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Each domain reviewer shall classify a finding by the affected requirement or assumption, evidence and uncertainty, consequence for the proposed decision, and proposed disposition. A disagreement about values or policy shall be identified as such rather than converted into an unexplained technical defect.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall respond to each material finding with acceptance, modification, reasoned non-acceptance, or deferral, linking the resulting text or action. A deferred finding shall retain an owner, next action, and explanation of whether progression is prevented.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where reviewers disagree across domains, the convenor shall preserve their respective questions, evidence, competence, and reasons and obtain a decision from the authority competent for the matter. A technical majority shall not substitute for an absent legal mandate or resolve a philosophical source conflict by assertion.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before recommending progression, the convenor shall verify that material findings and replies have been considered and that mandatory authority, evidence, rights, and protection conditions are satisfied. A decision to narrow scope shall identify the excluded behavior and prevent it from appearing in the resulting conformance claim.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A legal or institutional profile shall state its jurisdiction or forum, target action, relevant sources and status, claimed authority, temporal scope, unresolved conflicts, and reviewing competence. Generic technical conformance shall not replace assessment of actual applicability.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A policy proposal arising from committee work shall follow the separate policy-publication route and compare plausible institutional options, including existing infrastructure or deferral when relevant. The committee shall not present participation in technical review as assent to a policy recommendation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A jurisdictional or institutional reviewer shall distinguish a party's assertion, an applicable source identified by the reviewer, an institution's operative decision, and an unresolved interpretation. The profile shall state the temporal and contextual limits of that review.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For an institutional or international-policy proposal, the committee shall identify which technical findings are evidence for the proposal and which recommendations concern mandate, funding, distribution, oversight, or adoption choices. Unaccepted institutional participation shall remain prospective.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before a pilot begins, its record shall identify the case and baseline, questions and success criteria, participants and actual authority, material and access permissions, resource burden, anticipated harms, challenge and correction routes, stop conditions, and responsible reviewers. Synthetic cases shall be labelled synthetic.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The initial coordinated demonstration shall exercise a claim and its grounds, a consequential relation or contribution, an alternative or challenge, a reasoned response, a historical revision, a protected or unavailable record, and a presentation that makes their distinct status understandable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The pilot plan shall pin the requirement baseline, artifacts, scenario, input material, evaluation tasks, expected results, assessors, and comparison baseline before results are interpreted. A change during the exercise shall identify the reason and its effect on comparability.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For a real pilot, the responsible authority shall verify participant and institutional permissions, rights to material, protection arrangements, accessible challenge routes, available remedy, and stopping authority before the affected activity starts. A planned safeguard shall not be reported as operational without evidence of implementation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A pilot relying on restricted evidence shall identify how authorized assessors can evaluate the relevant requirement and how a public result can communicate limitations safely. Lack of public access shall not be equated with absence of evidence or accepted as proof of adequacy.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The pilot operator shall retain observations of performed tasks, relevant inputs and outputs, failures, participant assistance, departures from the plan, and protection incidents, within the approved access and retention conditions. Simulated events shall remain distinguishable from observed real behavior.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When a stopping condition is met or an unanticipated material harm or authority defect is identified, the pilot operator shall pause the affected activity, notify the responsible authority, protect necessary evidence, and obtain a recorded disposition before restart. Unaffected activity may continue only within its existing authority and safeguards.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A pilot restart shall identify the corrected condition, evidence that the response is operational, changed baseline or scope, required further permissions or notice, and the decision maker. A technically successful repair shall not alone establish restored participant protection.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Pilot findings shall report failed tasks, missing or conflicting evidence, excluded participants, unmet assumptions, and burdens alongside successful behavior. The committee shall trace each material finding to a requirement change, retained decision with reasons, further inquiry, or scope limitation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The evaluator shall report the actual participant population, excluded or unavailable perspectives, resource burden, supported tasks, failed cases, assistance required, uncertainty, and limits on transfer to other contexts. A small cooperative exercise shall not be presented as evidence of general institutional adoption.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall compare pilot results with the declared objectives and assessment criteria and trace each material finding to a requirement change, retained decision with reasons, further inquiry, or narrower claim. Unexpected benefits and harms shall be identified separately from the planned criteria.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Where an outcome depends on later institutional action or effects on future capacity, the report shall state whether that action or effect was observed, is pending, or was outside the study period. A corrected record shall not be treated as evidence that downstream consequences were repaired.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An implementation-evidence package shall identify source and artifact versions, configuration, test material, expected and actual outcomes, access or licence constraints, and instructions sufficient for an authorized reviewer to repeat the relevant assessment. Reproduction gaps shall be disclosed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For an independence claim, the convenor shall record who authored the requirements, implemented the artifacts, selected the cases, performed the assessment, and funded or controlled the work. The claimed degree of independence shall be limited to the separations actually evidenced.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: For each requested progression decision, the convenor shall assemble the current draft, requirement and source trace, comment dispositions, unresolved objections, multidisciplinary findings, pilot or other assessment evidence, rights-clearance status, and maintenance proposal. The programme decision authority shall apply Directives Part 1.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The progression dossier shall identify the requested decision and provide a requirement-by-requirement evidence status, unresolved finding register, dependency review, public-comment status where applicable, source and rights clearance, and implementation or pilot limitations. Missing evidence shall remain visible rather than being treated as tacit approval.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before forwarding a public-review or release package, an assigned reviewer shall check that the source, rendered document, associated artifacts, and declared status agree and that references, identifiers, and essential content remain usable. Material discrepancies shall be corrected through the applicable change procedure.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall retain a link from a corrected or superseded requirement to the prior text, reason, decision, affected dependencies, and migration consequence. Historical decisions shall remain distinguishable from the current authoritative edition.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall submit scope, participation, resource, and outstanding-risk information at its mandate review and when material conditions change. An inactive or unstaffed work item shall receive an explicit status and continuity disposition.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A substantive change shall identify affected requirements, interpretations, assessment fixtures, profiles, dependencies, existing users, and migration consequences. The maintenance owner shall distinguish a correction from an altered obligation and invoke the corresponding Directives route.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: On evidence of a serious defect or loss of a necessary dependency, the convenor shall notify the authorized maintenance or release holder with the affected versions, evidence, consequences, and proposed interim response. The committee shall not issue a permanent normative change through an informal implementation update.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An assessment of committee performance shall declare the activity, period, mandate and governance editions, assessor, interests, applicable TC requirements, evidence, and result for each requirement. Results shall distinguish fulfilled, not fulfilled, not assessed, and not applicable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessment shall include a trace from a selected material problem through source interpretation, candidate requirement, alternatives, assessment method, pilot or review evidence, disposition, and authorized decision. Breaks in the trace shall be recorded with their effect on the claimed readiness.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The convenor shall assign owners and review dates for material performance findings and report unresolved scope, participation, capacity, or protection issues to the programme decision authority. Closing an action shall identify evidence of completion and any remaining limitation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The committee shall maintain a work-item and baseline record containing the authorized problem and scope, decision and mandate, output classes, accepted roles, sources, dependencies, versions, requirements, assessment methods, review milestones, permissions, resources, and remaining conditions. Each substantive update shall identify the responsible actor and reason.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The editor shall maintain a trace for each material requirement identifying its stable identifier, responsible publication, condition and subject, source passage or operational proposal, alternatives, decision rationale, assessment method, evidence, dependency versions, and unresolved question. Superseded interpretations shall remain linked to their replacements.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A domain finding record shall identify the question, scope, reviewer and competence, relevant interests, evidence and access limitations, assessed alternatives, finding and reasons, progression effect, response, reply, action owner, and closure evidence. A safe public account shall be linked where the full record is restricted.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A pilot record shall identify its authorization, actual participants, baseline versions, scenario, data and permissions, evaluation tasks, expected and actual outcomes, failures, burdens, deviations, stopping or restart decisions, evidence limitations, and requirement dispositions. Synthetic and independent elements shall be explicitly identified.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The convenor shall provide an index linking the current baseline, scope decision, review and comment dispositions, pilot evidence, blocking findings, rights status, artifact manifest, maintenance assignment, and requested decision. The index shall identify unavailable or incomplete elements and their proposed treatment.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The responsible handler shall identify the operative policy and procedure editions for each matter and record any conflict affecting authority, timing, protection, or available remedy. A consequential dependent determination shall await resolution of a material conflict within actual authority.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall identify the adopted edition, effective scope, responsible ethics contact and alternate, protected reporting route, decision authority, and neutral-review route before treating this policy as operational. Until then it shall retain Governance Working Draft status.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall assess conduct, conflicts, substantive impacts, and contribution rights through distinguishable findings. A favorable finding in one area shall not be represented as clearance in another.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The governance authority shall assign an ethics contact, an alternate, conflict-decision responsibility, competent rights review, record custody, and neutral procedural review before relying on those functions. Each holder shall accept a bounded mandate and declare interests; an unassigned function shall remain visibly unavailable.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The ethics contact shall receive and triage reports, arrange appropriate consideration, communicate status, and protect access. The investigator or assessor shall examine the stated question; the authorized decision maker shall determine programme findings and remedies. Where functions are combined, the record shall identify resulting limits and independent review needed.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before opening a protected reporting route, the custodian shall verify restricted access, a safe alternate contact, retention arrangements, incident handling, and the information provided to reporters about confidentiality limits. If the route fails, the custodian shall publish or directly provide a safe alternative and prevent further avoidable disclosure.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The responsible authority shall provide information on feasible assistance with language, access, or submission format and shall record unmet needs and their effect on fair consideration. A person shall not be required to expose protected information publicly to obtain assistance.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A material capacity gap in impartial handling, rights competence, or protection shall be reported to the governance authority with a proposed reassignment, narrower scope, or deferral. Continued drafting within existing permission shall remain distinct from approval of the affected use or finding.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Participants acting in programme roles shall not engage in harassment, threats, retaliation, discriminatory exclusion, or coercive disclosure of protected information. Critical disagreement about sources, methods, policy, and requirements shall remain eligible for reasoned consideration.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A participant presenting a factual or source-based claim shall distinguish observation, quotation, interpretation, inference, and proposal where that distinction affects review. Known material errors, fabricated evidence, or falsely attributed sources shall not be retained as support after discovery without correction or explicit disputed status.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Editors shall preserve attribution of material contributions and competing positions within actual permissions and protection needs. Authorship, acknowledgement, evidential reliability, ownership, and decision authority shall remain distinct.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A participant identifying a material error in their earlier contribution shall notify the responsible editor and supply the correction or known uncertainty. The editor shall assess affected arguments, decisions, and artifacts and retain an attributable correction record.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A claim that a contribution was deliberately fabricated or knowingly misattributed shall be assessed through the conduct procedure. A disputed interpretation, incomplete evidence, ordinary error, or unsubstantiated report shall not by itself establish intentional misconduct.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A participant using AI assistance for a material draft, analysis, evidence synthesis, or disposition proposal shall identify the consequential assistance and the responsible human reviewer in the development record. The reviewer shall verify material sources and conclusions before relying on them.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Participants shall not submit protected, confidential, or third-party material to a tool or service without an established basis for that disclosure. Uncertainty about such a basis shall be resolved before the disclosure.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A consequential AI-use record shall identify the task, material source categories, transformations relied on, responsible human reviewer, verification performed, and known limits relevant to the resulting claim. Protected prompts or source contents shall not be exposed solely to demonstrate that assistance occurred.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When external processing terms or data handling change materially, the responsible user shall reassess permitted disclosure and reliance before further affected use. A tool's technical availability shall not establish permission to disclose material or confidence in its output.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before accepting a decision or review role and when relevant circumstances change, a participant shall disclose interests that could materially affect, or reasonably call into question, their impartial performance of that role. The disclosure shall include relevant financial, employment, funding, authorship, institutional, personal, and infrastructural-control interests.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The responsible coordinator shall record a conflict assessment, its author, the affected decision, the disclosed interest, protection limits, and the selected management action. Disclosure alone shall not be treated as resolving a conflict.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A person shall not determine the disposition of a complaint against themselves, act as neutral reviewer of their own decision, or independently assess a rights clearance in which they have an unresolved material interest. The alternate route shall be used.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Conflict management shall identify whether disclosure with oversight, separation of roles, partial recusal, replacement, or deferral is required. A recusal shall identify the decision scope and substitute authority without suppressing relevant technical evidence from the recused contributor.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The decision authority shall examine material concentration of funding, affiliation, available unpaid labor, infrastructure access, and agenda control when assessing fair consideration. If the concentration impairs review, it shall record corrective measures and reassess progression.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: An interest disclosure shall identify the affected role or decision, nature and duration of the interest, relevant relationships, and protection needs. The conflict assessor shall distinguish an actual conflict, a reasonably perceived conflict needing management, and an interest not material to the stated role, with reasons.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before the affected decision proceeds, the conflict assessor shall communicate the management decision to the role holder and responsible chair and record any objection. A challenged assessment involving the assessor's own interests shall be referred to the alternate or neutral route.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A recusal arrangement shall identify prohibited decision participation, permitted factual or technical contribution, access limitations where justified, substitute authority, duration, and reconsideration trigger. The chair shall verify that the recusal was applied and record its consequence for eligibility or quorum.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: If an undisclosed material interest is discovered after a decision, the governance authority shall assess the affected procedure and outcome, obtain independent consideration where needed, and record whether disclosure, renewed review, repeated decision, or another remedy is required. Retrospective disclosure shall not alone cure a defective process.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Measures addressing concentrated influence shall identify the actual mechanism, such as agenda control, dependence on one host, repeated affiliations, or unequal time resources, and the proposed response. The assessment shall not treat head count alone as evidence of balanced influence or stigmatize a contributor solely for an affiliation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The programme shall provide a reporting route to an ethics contact and an alternate independent of a reported person. Its notice shall explain receipt handling, who can access material, limits on confidentiality, possible outcomes, record retention, and the procedural-review route.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A report shall receive acknowledgement, triage, status communication, and a reasoned disposition. The seven-calendar-day acknowledgement requirement in D1-035 and the 30-calendar-day initial-determination target, with reasoned extensions notified before expiry, in D1-036 shall apply to report handling without converting the report into a procedural appeal. An extension of the determination target shall not extend the acknowledgement requirement. Triage shall distinguish immediate protection needs, conduct issues, procedural appeals, substantive technical objections, and record-specific correction or access requests.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A report shall not be rejected solely because its author requests protected handling or lacks a formal role. The reviewer shall record whether limited identity or unavailable evidence constrains investigation and what fair assessment remains possible.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: At intake, the ethics contact shall assign a stable identifier, record the reported concern and relevant programme connection, acknowledge the requested protection, identify immediate risk, and explain the next handling step. Requests for additional information shall be limited to what is needed for that step.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Triage shall identify scope, required authority and competence, potential conflicts, available evidence, immediate protection needs, and whether another programme or external route is relevant. A referral shall preserve the original receipt history and explain what the programme will and will not determine.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: When a report contains both a technical objection and a conduct allegation, the handler shall provide linked but distinct handling records. The technical concern shall not lose consideration because the conduct allegation is unsubstantiated, and a conduct concern shall not be dismissed solely because the technical proposal is accepted.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The handler shall assess an anonymous or partly identified report to the extent supported by available information and record limits on verification, reply, and remedy. Identity disclosure shall not be demanded without a stated handling need and consideration of a less intrusive alternative.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A repeated submission shall be linked to earlier handling and assessed for new evidence, unaddressed grounds, or changed circumstances. Limits on repetitive or abusive contact shall state the conduct basis, safe route for materially new information, scope, review date, and challenge route. Mere persistence in disagreement shall not establish abuse.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before an adverse conduct finding, the responsible reviewer shall provide the affected person a sufficient account of the concern and an opportunity to respond, using redaction or a protected intermediary when necessary. Where protection prevents a fair determination, that limitation shall remain explicit.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: Before a substantive inquiry, the appointed assessor shall state the questions, applicable programme rules, scope, evidence sources, access arrangements, opportunities to respond, intended timetable, and decision authority. A material expansion shall be notified to affected participants with an adequate response opportunity.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessor shall distinguish direct information, testimony, contemporaneous records, inference, hearsay, and disputed interpretation where that distinction affects the finding. Relevant contrary evidence and plausible alternative explanations shall be examined; source status alone shall not determine credibility.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessor shall document evidential gaps and the reasons material may be unavailable, including protection, loss, or lack of access. An unavailable record or a person's inability to participate shall not automatically be treated as proof of the alleged conduct or its absence.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: A response invitation shall identify the material concern and grounds sufficiently for a meaningful reply, the response route and deadline, available assistance, and the proposed decision scope. If safe disclosure cannot support a fair finding, the limitation shall prevent an unsupported adverse determination.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The assessor shall avoid unnecessary repeated disclosure of sensitive experiences and shall record how protected testimony can be tested fairly through safe summaries, questions, or an authorized intermediary. A summary materially interpreted by another person shall retain that mediation and any confirmation or dispute by its source.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register

requirement_text: The handler shall obtain an appropriate rights and protection assessment before disclosing case material to an external institution. A claimed obligation to disclose shall identify the competent authority, context, basis, and unresolved questions; the policy itself shall not be treated as creating that obligation.
p1_whole_requirement_assessment: not assessed in the P1 register
